apps.name: dali-nrf54
apps.title: DALI-2 Dual-Core Lighting Control Add-on for nRF54L15
apps.description: Developed by N-iX in partnership with Nordic Semiconductor, this add-on runs the timing-critical DALI runtime on the nRF54L15 FLPR RISC-V core and exposes a CPUAPP-facing API over IPC. In our controller test setup, DALI network setup used about 0.5% CPUAPP load without the optional BLE workload, while median peak-to-peak TX packet jitter was 0.8 us. The controller sample supports device discovery, addressed and broadcast on/off, level control, status and actual-level queries.
